purpose: A browser-only playable WFC cave prototype using fixed illustrated macro modules, retaining the existing continuous-material candidate.
layout: Two columns by three rows. Six 768x512 side-view cave modules.
precision: Deterministic layout guide defines portal classes A and B and collision envelopes. Generated illustration requires visual review; source bytes preserved.
rendering: Rigid translated module illustrations. No looping rock fill or freely bent floor texture. Fixed portal overlays may hide seams and are listed separately.
generationMethod: Built-in image_gen, guided by exact module layout and the user's cave reference. This is a large illustrated asset, not a low pixel count tile.
alpha: Opaque panels; no alpha required. Guide is opaque.
scope: One horizontal WFC strip, desktop and touch movement and jumping, camera follow, macro and rule views. Prototype physics only; no Unity integration or official gameplay values.
